description:
An e-commerce company has a comprehensive order fulfillment process:
When a customer places an order, the system records the order details.
Payment processing begins.
If the payment fails, the customer is notified, and the process ends.
Upon successful payment, the inventory system checks stock availability.
If items are out of stock, a back-order is initiated, and the customer is informed about the delay.
The process continues once the back-order is received and all required items are available in stock.
In-stock items are picked from the warehouse.
Quality control checks are performed on the picked items.
Packaging is done, including gift wrapping if the customer requested it.
Meanwhile, the shipping department prepares shipping documents and labels.
If the order is international, customs documentation is prepared.
Once packaging and shipping documents are ready, the order is dispatched.
The system sends a shipping confirmation to the customer.
After dispatch, the system updates the inventory levels.
A follow-up email for feedback is sent directly after confirming the successful delivery.
If the customer reports any issues upon delivery, a returns process is initiated, which includes:
Sending a return shipping label.
Receiving returned items.
Inspecting returned items.
Processing a refund or replacement.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment"
                  exporter="BPMN modeler"
                  exporterVersion="1.0">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="E-commerce Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderPlaced_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderPlaced_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Payment</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentSplit" name="Payment successful?" default="Flow_PaymentOk">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentFailed</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentOk</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" name="Notify customer of payment failure">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentFailed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyFailure_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PaymentFailed" name="Process ended: payment failed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyFailure_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PaymentOk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stock_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Items in stock?" default="Flow_InStock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stock_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OutOfStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_InitiateBackOrder" name="Initiate back-order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OutOfStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BackOrder_Inform</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformDelay" name="Inform customer of delay">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BackOrder_Inform</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inform_BackOrderReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_BackOrderReceived" name="Back-order received and all items in stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inform_BackOrderReceived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BackOrderReceived_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BackOrderReceived_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Pick</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick items from warehouse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Pick</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pick_QC</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_QualityControl" name="Perform quality control">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pick_QC</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_QC_PrepSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepSplit" name="Start packaging and shipping preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_QC_PrepSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepSplit_Gift</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepSplit_ShipDocs</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftSplit" name="Gift wrapping requested?" default="Flow_NoGiftWrap">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepSplit_Gift</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GiftWrap</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoGiftWrap</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GiftWrap</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GiftWrap_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftMerge" name="Gift wrapping decided">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GiftWrap_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoGiftWrap</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GiftMerge_Pack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PackOrder" name="Pack order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GiftMerge_Pack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pack_PrepJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepSplit_ShipDocs</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShipDocs_IntlSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IntlSplit" name="International order?" default="Flow_Domestic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipDocs_IntlSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Intl</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Domestic</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CustomsDocs" name="Prepare customs documentation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Intl</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customs_IntlMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IntlMerge" name="Shipping documents complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customs_IntlMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Domestic</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IntlMerge_PrepJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepJoin" name="Packaging and documents ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pack_PrepJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IntlMerge_PrepJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrepJoin_Dispatch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Dispatch" name="Dispatch order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrepJoin_Dispatch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Dispatch_Confirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Dispatch_Confirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_UpdateInventory</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_UpdateInventory</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateInventory_Delivery</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Successful delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateInventory_Delivery</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delivery_IssueSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IssueSplit" name="Customer reports issue upon delivery?" default="Flow_NoIssue">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delivery_IssueSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoIssue</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Issue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" name="Send feedback follow-up email">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoIssue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Feedback_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Feedback_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Issue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReturnLabel_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReturnLabel_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InspectReturnedItems" name="Inspect returned items">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Refund</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement" name="Process refund or replacement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Refund</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Refund_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReturnProcessed" name="Return processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Refund_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderPlaced_Record" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Payment" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentFailed" name="Payment failed" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentFailed}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentOk" name="Payment successful" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyFailure_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stock_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutOfStock" name="Out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${outOfStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BackOrder_Inform" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackOrder" targetRef="Task_InformDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inform_BackOrderReceived" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Event_BackOrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BackOrderReceived_Merge" sourceRef="Event_BackOrderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Pick" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pick_QC" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityControl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QC_PrepSplit" sourceRef="Task_QualityControl" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_Gift" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Gateway_GiftSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_ShipDocs" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftSplit" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${giftWrapRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGiftWrap" name="No gift wrapping" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftSplit" targetRef="Gateway_GiftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftWrap_Merge" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GiftMerge_Pack" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftMerge" targetRef="Task_PackOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pack_PrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipDocs_IntlSplit" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_IntlSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Intl" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlSplit" targetRef="Task_CustomsDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalOrder}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Domestic" name="Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlSplit" targetRef="Gateway_IntlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customs_IntlMerge" sourceRef="Task_CustomsDocs" targetRef="Gateway_IntlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IntlMerge_PrepJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_IntlMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepJoin_Dispatch" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepJoin" targetRef="Task_Dispatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Dispatch_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_Dispatch" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_UpdateInventory" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateInventory_Delivery" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivery_IssueSplit" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_IssueSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoIssue" name="No issue reported" sourceRef="Gateway_IssueSplit" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issue" name="Issue reported" sourceRef="Gateway_IssueSplit" targetRef="Task_SendReturnLabel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${issueReported}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnLabel_Receive" sourceRef="Task_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Refund" sourceRef="Task_InspectReturnedItems" targetRef="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund_End" sourceRef="Task_ProcessRefundOrReplacement" targetRef="EndEvent_ReturnProcessed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_OrderFulfillment" bpmnElement="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
